title: Area 51 programs moved to Dugway Proving Ground
place_text: Dugway Proving Ground, Utah; Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: And he always quotes that 35 to 40% of programs at Area 51 were moved to Dougway in Utah. Well, if you look at ah's testimony in 2000, the year 2000 recorded, he says the exact same thing.

plain: Between 35 and 40 percent of the secret programmes at Area 51 were moved to Dugway Proving Ground, an Army test range in Utah. A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb tells Michels that Steven Greer, a UFO activist, always quotes that figure, and that a witness known only as AH says the exact same thing in testimony recorded in 2000, which UAPGerb found in a collection of recorded witness interviews he calls the DPI archive. If true, Utah would be a new centre of the work once done at Area 51.
